_meta.data_source: JCR 2023/2024 categories (CARDIAC, OB/GYN, PEDIATRICS, ENDOCRINOLOGY), cross-checked với SJR 2024. Một số IF là ước lượng.

tier_definitions.Q1: Top 25% - Tier 1 - Nên cite, abstract/full verified
tier_definitions.Q4: Bottom 25% / predatory - Tier 4 - Tránh cite (block nếu có số liệu cụ thể)

_meta.how_to_add_journal: Thêm journal mới khi gặp, đặc biệt journal thường xuyên cite. Nếu không rõ quartile, mặc định Tier 3 (cân nhắc).
_meta.coverage: 60+ OB/GYN/ART, 25+ Cardiology (fetal echo), 15+ Pediatrics/Neonatology, 15+ Endocrinology/Molecular, 10+ General medicine, 5+ misc

Fertility and Sterility.notes: ASRM flagship. PGT-A committee opinions 2024, 2023; Mumusoglu 2025 unexplained RPL; Bayefsky 2026 donor egg PGT-A; Sakkas time-lapse.

Human Reproduction.notes: ESHRE flagship. Hyttel 2026 PGT-A obstetric outcomes meta-analysis; Verpoest 2018 STAR trial sub-analysis; Cornelisse 2024 miRNA.

Human Reproduction Open.notes: ESHRE open-access. Song 2025 polar body + nanopore PGT-A.

Human Reproduction Update.notes: ESHRE top review journal (IF cao nhất OB/GYN). Lambalk 2017 IPD meta antagonist vs agonist; Venetis 2023 NMA antagonist protocols; Al-Inany 2016 Cochrane antagonists.

Reproductive BioMedicine Online.notes: Reproductive Healthcare Ltd. Ata 2024 PPOS review; Chen 2022 FP breast cancer meta; Vaiarelli 2018 DuoStim SWOT.

Frontiers in Endocrinology.notes: Frontiers journal. Guan 2021 PPOS meta; Yang 2023 PPOS PCOS; Yang 2022 PPOS endometrioma; Qin 2025 PPOS PGT-A.

Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Gen.notes: ASRM society journal. Glujovsky 2020 non-conventional protocols NMA; La Marca 2026 DuoStim extended; Mercorio 2026 dual trigger poor responders.

Reproductive Biology and Endocrinology.notes: BMC/Springer Nature open-access journal. Xu 2018 CoQ10 pretreatment in low-prognosis young women.

Acta Obstetricia et Gynecologica Scandin.notes: Nordic OB/GYN (NFOG). Newnham 2026 RIF PGT-A meta-analysis.

EClinicalMedicine.notes: Lancet open-access clinical journal. Xin 2024 AI for embryonic ploidy meta-analysis.

Genetics.notes: Genetics Society of America flagship. Yang 2025 ABC mosaicism rate blastocysts.

Physiological Reviews.notes: Top physiology review journal (APS). Gimpl & Fahrenholz 2001 OXTR classic; Jurek & Neumann 2018 OXTR behavior.

Journal of Biological Chemistry.notes: Q1 general biochemistry (high volume). Reversi 2005 atosiban biased mechanism.

Endocrinology.notes: Endocrine Society flagship. Larcher 1995 OXTR expression uterus.

Trends in Endocrinology and Metabolism.notes: Cell Press review journal. Zingg 2003 OXTR.

Molecular Human Reproduction.notes: ESHRE journal. Moran 2002 Rho kinase myometrium.

Biochimica et Biophysica Acta.notes: BBA family of journals. Tsujimoto 2005 oxytocinase subfamily.

PLoS ONE.notes: Open access multidisciplinary. Kruit 2022 oxytocin IOL Helsinki cohort.

Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews.notes: Top evidence synthesis. Kerr 2021 oral misoprostol IOL.

American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynec.notes: ACOG flagship journal. Top OB/GYN journal. SMFM Consult Series, Chauhan 2004 AFI vs SDP, Johnson 2007 oligo criteria.

American Journal of Obstetrics & Gynecol.notes: ACOG companion journal. Grasch 2025 high vs low-dose; Nicol 2026 TOLAC.

AJOG Global Reports.notes: ACOG open-access companion. Carvajal 2024 RHOA/ROCK myometrium.

American Journal of Physiology.notes: APS consolidated journal. Caritis 1987 myometrial desensitization classic.

American Journal of Physiology - Gastroi.abbr: Am J Physiol Gastrointest Liver Physiol
American Journal of Physiology - Gastroi.notes: APS GI/Liver. Sohn 2001 MLCK-PKC smooth muscle contraction.

Healthcare.notes: MDPI open access. Q1 in Health Policy. Zaman 2025 dinoprostone vs Foley meta-analysis.

Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology.notes: Official journal ISUOG. Top impact in OB ultrasound (IF ~ 7). PMID 19031473 Kagan 2009 TR screening, 37267096 ISUOG 2023 guideline.

Clinics in Perinatology.notes: Elsevier. McLaughlin 2016 fetal diagnostics sequential segmental approach.

Prenatal Diagnosis.notes: Journal quốc tế về chẩn đoán trước sinh. IF ~ 3. PMID 27060369 Burger 2016 DV anatomy.

BJOG: An International Journal of Obstet.notes: Top OB/GYN journal UK (RCOG). IF ~ 5.8. PMID 12269675 Mavrides 2002 DV Doppler screening.

Radiology.notes: RSNA flagship. Chow 2016 spleen size normal values 1200 individuals. Tier 1.

Ultrasound in Medicine & Biology.notes: WFUMB official journal. Trenker 2021 spleen IF, Dietrich 2022 liver IF, Jenssen 2022 gallbladder IF. Tier 1.

Ultraschall in der Medizin.notes: EFSUMB official journal. EFSUMB 2016 CEUS guidelines. Tier 1.

Cancers.notes: MDPI open access. Șirli 2024 WFUMB liver incidental findings. Tier 1.

European Radiology.notes: European Society of Radiology flagship. Vassallo 2026 ESR thyroid imaging essentials. Tier 1.

Radiographics.notes: RSNA review journal. Retson 2026 BI-RADS 6th edition lymph node review. Tier 1.

Thyroid.notes: American Thyroid Association flagship. Cibas 2017 Bethesda System. Tier 1.

Obstetrics and Gynecology.notes: ACOG flagship. 2021 PB #231 multifetal; 2017 CO #719 MFPR; 2016 CO #671 ART perinatal risks.

JAMA Network Open.notes: JAMA family open access. Matsuzaki 2024 gestational carrier outcomes.

European Journal of Obstetrics, Gynecolo.abbr: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
European Journal of Obstetrics, Gynecolo.notes: Elsevier. Sopa 2019 AMH algorithm; Liu 2023 poor responder RCT.

International Journal of Gynecology & Ob.notes: FIGO official journal. Diaz 2025 FIGO fibroid guidance; Kitahara 2024 AUB diagnosis.

Best Practice & Research Clinical Obstet.abbr: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
Best Practice & Research Clinical Obstet.notes: Elsevier review journal. Munro 2016 FIGO systems practical aspects.

Journal of Ultrasound in Medicine.notes: AIUM official journal. AIUM 2024 female pelvis ultrasound practice parameter.

Archives of Gynecology and Obstetrics.notes: Springer OB/GYN. Jiang 2026 misdiagnosis PGT meta-analysis; Hochberg 2025 blastocyst morphology PGT-A; Qin 2025 PPOS PGT-A.

Journal of the American College of Radio.notes: ACR official journal. Mody 2021 adrenal mass ACR appropriateness criteria. Tier 2.

Canadian Association of Radiologists Jou.notes: CAR official journal. Fienberg 2026 breast ultrasound practice guidelines. Tier 2.

European Journal of Medical Research.notes: Springer open access. Wan 2025 sperm DNA fragmentation + embryo euploidy.

Genes.notes: MDPI open access genetics. Navarro-Sanchez 2026 niPGT-A multicenter.

Vitamins and Hormones.notes: Academic Press series. Mayasich 2020 vasotocin origin.

Journal of Gynecology Obstetrics and Hum.notes: Elsevier French OB/GYN journal. Pieux 2025 misoprostol vs dinoprostone; Mashayekhi 2021 POSEIDON LBR; Tian 2023 endometriosis downregulation meta; Alexander 2021 random start FP cancer.

Therapeutic Advances in Reproductive Hea.notes: SAGE open access. Drakopoulos 2020 POSEIDON concept; Di Guardo 2022 natural cycle poor responder; Kuan 2023 endometriosis GnRH comparison.

Journal of Ovarian Research.notes: Springer open access. Huang 2022 random-start PPOS for FP.

Gynecological Endocrinology.notes: Taylor & Francis. Fernandez-Sanchez 2023 OHSS risk GnRH trigger freeze-all; Sekiguchi 2023 DuoStim AML FP.

Medicina (Kaunas).notes: MDPI. Criscione 2025 tubal stump EP after IVF-ET.

Biomedicines.notes: MDPI. Chen 2026 personalized FSH in PCOS.

Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology.notes: Taylor Francis. Barrenetxea 2023 Spain Delphi consensus.

F S Sci.notes: ASRM family, sister journal of Fertility and Sterility. Luque-González 2026 HyFoSy vs HSG.

Quantitative Imaging in Medicine and Sur.notes: AME Publishing. Du 2026 perfluoropropane HyCoSy phase III.

Medicine (Baltimore).notes: Wolters Kluwer. Tao 2026 venous intravasation HyCoSy case report.

Research and Practice in Thrombosis and.notes: ISTH open access. Masood 2025 AUB + bleeding disorders systematic review.

BMC Women's Health.notes: BMC. Jiang 2026 mifepristone refractory HMB in bleeding disorders.

European Journal of Contraception and Re.abbr: Eur J Contracept Reprod Health Care
European Journal of Contraception and Re.notes: Taylor & Francis. Tsakiridis 2022 AUB guidelines comparison review.

Ciba Foundation Symposia.notes: Historical symposium series (1977-era). Liggins 1977 'Parturition in the sheep' is a classic foundational reference; cited for historical context only.

Endocr Metab Immune Disord Drug Targets.abbr: Endocr Metab Immune Disord Drug Targets

Results Probl Cell Differ.notes: Springer book series. Cited for historical reviews.

Prog Brain Res.notes: Elsevier book series. Often Q2/Q3 depending on year; classify as Q3.

Journal of Medical Ultrasonics.notes: Journal Hội siêu âm Nhật Bản. PMID 41854925 Yonehara 2026 sample volume position.

Journal of Human Reproductive Sciences.notes: Indian Society of Assisted Reproduction. Kumar 2022 random start case reports.

Cureus.notes: Springer. Triantafyllidou 2026 clomiphene + low-dose antagonist. Cân nhắc vì impact factor thấp + open access wide.

African Journal of Reproductive Health.notes: Pan African. Fu 2026 multimodal HyCoSy tubal patency.

Case Reports in Obstetrics and Gynecolog.notes: Hindawi open access. Bisogni 2024 spontaneous pregnancy after 4D-HyCoSy.

Medical Sciences (Basel).notes: MDPI open access. Xydias 2025 HyFoSy vs HyCoSy meta-analysis.

Journal of Medicine and Life.notes: Romanian journal. Ichim 2026 acute AUB hospital management review.

Medical Ultrasonography.notes: Romanian ultrasound journal. Muresan 2016 complete AVSD prenatal diagnosis.

Q4_AVOID._description: Tier 4 - Tránh cite. Bao gồm predatory journals, hijacked journals, low-quality.
Q4_AVOID._examples_only: List này để reference. Có thể mở rộng khi phát hiện journal predatory cụ thể.

Anales de la Real Academia Nacional de M.notes: Spanish regional, low IF, consider avoiding.

Hindawi - Evidence-Based Complementary a.notes: Hindawi bị reclassify, từng predatory. Check cẩn thận.

Journal of SAFOG.notes: South Asian Federation of OB/GYN - check status.

Khirurgiia.notes: Russian surgery journal. If cited for non-Russian-surgery claim = wrong topic.

Ugeskrift for Laeger.notes: Danish medical journal. If cited for non-Danish = wrong topic.

Virologie.notes: French virology. If cited in non-virology context = wrong topic.

Zentralblatt fur Gynakologie.notes: Old German gyn, no longer active.
